name: cpp_unit_tests_benchmark_data
description: A collection of C++ programming problems paired with unit tests designed to evaluate models' ability to generate correct, compilable C++ code that passes automated tests. It is intended for benchmarking code-generation and program-synthesis capabilities (e.g., generating functions or solutions) by checking generated outputs against provided unit tests. Useful for measuring robustness to language- and API-specific details of C++ and for assessing test-driven correctness.
reputation: A small Hugging Face dataset used by researchers evaluating code-generation models; not a widely standardized benchmark but useful for targeted C++ unit-test evaluations.
